claims.statement: Visa says merchants may challenge chargebacks with receipts, shipping records, and customer communications, and CE3.0 uses structured transaction evidence.
Demand hypothesis: smaller PSPs will buy an evidence layer because manual reviews consume resources and network-specific criteria reward complete structured data.

contrary_evidence: Visa and established vendors already offer dispute tools.
Network rules and access can favor certified incumbent providers.

economics.acquisition_route: Win one PSP or commerce-platform integration rather than individual merchants.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 100000 monthly disputes at 5 PLN can produce 6 million PLN annual revenue and founder equity above 5 million PLN in five years.
economics.founder_time: Four hours daily during payment-network integration.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 85-93% margin for automated evidence assembly and scoring.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 10000 monthly disputes at 5 PLN repay initial capital within eighteen months.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 2-8 PLN per dispute plus 8-15% of recovered value under a platform contract.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Disputes and data retention operate continuously across merchant portfolios.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Merchant-specific evidence completeness and dispute outcomes improve decisioning and retention.
fingerprint.customer: EU subscription merchants, marketplaces, payment facilitators, and acquirers.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Acquirers, PSPs, and commerce platforms embed it into merchant operations.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: The API preserves eligible evidence and returns a network-rule-specific response or refund recommendation.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: A payment platform or merchant pays per transaction monitored and dispute represented.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A cardholder dispute requests supporting evidence from systems that use different identifiers and retention periods.

founder_fit: Fraud and evidence scoring suit data-science strengths.
Embedded distribution avoids a personal brand and merchant-by-merchant sales.
risks: Poor evidence matching could increase losses or dispute ratios.
Payment data creates PCI and privacy obligations.

structure.commercial_archetype: Embedded payment-dispute decision and evidence rail.
structure.critical_dependency: Acquirer submission access and reliable merchant data joins.

thesis: An acquirer-embedded evidence graph can assemble order, identity, delivery, communication, and prior-transaction proof before a card dispute deadline.
title: Merchant Dispute Evidence Graph
uncertainties: Unserved PSP dispute volume is unknown.
